audit.whatIsWrong: The page is labelled EVEN at 6/10 while the actual win rate is 45.65% — the worst number in this slice. The chart itself is already honest (Poppy 4 / Skill 3 / K'Sante 0) and full and content agree row for row, so the rows are not the problem; the headline difficulty is.
audit.why: A 45.65% lane presented as 'even' tells the player to take trades this matchup does not give them. I have not edited diff or diffRating because that is a champion-level calibration decision the user should make deliberately rather than one agent nudging it mid-run — see questionsForUser.
audit.corrected: No row flips. Difficulty label flagged for the user rather than changed unilaterally.

audit.why: Spike order is right and the level-6 call is the important one: All Out (120/100/80s) against Keeper's Verdict (140/120/100s) means your ultimate is back first at every rank, which is why 6 is genuinely your one clean window in a lane you otherwise lose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four things. (1) 'Q3's knock-up-and-pull' twice — Ntofo Strikes slows and PULLS at two stacks, never knocks up. (2) 'her Q knock-up' and 'then Q knock-up and grind' — Hammer Shock has no knock-up at all; Riot's text is a slow zone that explodes after a delay. Poppy's only knock-up is Keeper's Verdict. (3) 'her W blocks your E dash' understates it badly: Steadfast Presence stops ALL dashes around her — Path Maker, Footwork AND All Out's dash — and grounds the victim on top of the slow. (4) mid tells you to 'bait her W block onto a throwaway Q'; Ntofo Strikes is not a dash, so it cannot bait a dash-stopper. The bait has to be a Footwork dash.
audit.why: Item 4 is the one that gets a K'Sante killed: following that instruction means walking into the fight with Steadfast Presence still up and every one of your three dashes turned off. Item 3 is the defining interaction of this entire matchup and it was written as if it only hit one ability.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence (20/18/16/14/12s, 400 range) stops enemy dashes around her and slows plus grounds whatever it catches — that is your W, your E and your R. Bait it with a throwaway Footwork dash, then commit inside the 20s. Heroic Charge (14/13/12/11/10s) dashes and pushes you back, stunning only into a wall. Hammer Shock (8/7/6/5/4s) is a slowing zone that explodes. Ntofo Strikes pulls at two stacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Keeper's Verdict 'cancels your R peel' and stops there, leaving the player with no counterplay to it at all.
audit.why: Riot's own text says Poppy CHANNELS the hammer strike. A channel is interruptible, and you carry two interrupts — Path Maker's stun and the Ntofo Strikes pull. Holding one for her wind-up is the single highest-value thing you can do in a teamfight against her, and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Written into the late paragraph: her R is a channel, so hold Path Maker or a Q stack for the wind-up and cancel it.
sources: enemyKit R text ('channels a hammer strike')

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo is online and you can land Q3's knock-up-and-pull, but she trades evenly with steadfast bulk so neither side commits.
edits.after: Your full combo is online and the second Q stack pulls her in, but she trades evenly with Steadfast Presence bulk so neither commits.

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to Poppy — you only have Q with no engage, and her passive lets her chuck a shield and poke you off the wave while you last-hit. Don't walk into her Q knock-up range to throw a Q3 you can't finish yet. By Levels 2-3 you get Path Maker and your full Q-W combo, so the lane levels out, but respect her W: it blocks your E dash flat, and her E will pin you to a wall for a long stun if you E in carelessly. Farm with the tip of Q, take the even trades, and wait for your spike.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to Poppy — you only have Q with no engage, and Iron Ambassador lets her throw a buckler, pick it up for a shield, and poke you off the wave. Don't step into Hammer Shock's slow zone for a stack you can't finish yet. By Levels 2-3 you get Path Maker and the full combo, so the lane levels out, but respect Steadfast Presence: it stops your W, E and R dashes outright and grounds you, and Heroic Charge pins you to a wall for a stun. Farm at the tip of Q and wait for your spike.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a grind — she trades evenly because her steadfast bulk eats your stacking-armor pressure and her E stun answers your W charge. Don't dash with E into her wall setups. Your real window is Level 6: All Out converts you out of tank stats into a duelist with bonus range and penetration, and that profile wins the straight 1v1 she can't escape (she has no dash but E). Bait her W block onto a throwaway Q, then R through her and run it down — this is your one clean kill window before she has items.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a grind — she trades evenly because her steadfast bulk eats your armour pressure and Heroic Charge answers your W charge. Don't dash in with E into her wall setups. Your real window is Level 6: All Out converts you out of tank stats into a duelist with bonus range and penetration, and that profile wins the straight 1v1. Bait Steadfast Presence with a throwaway Footwork dash — it is 20s at rank 1 — then R her and run it down. This is your one clean kill window before she items up.

edits.before: This is where Poppy reclaims it. Her Heartsteel stacking and steadfast HP grow faster than your armor matters, and crucially her R hard-counters your whole pattern — she can W-block your E engage and ult your team away the moment you R a carry in, so your peel just gets cancelled. You can't out-scale her bulk-for-bulk, so don't bet on the very late 1v1. Use your earlier-to-mid windows and your first-item disruption to side-lane and close, because the longer this runs the more her anti-engage kit neutralizes everything you do.
edits.after: This is where Poppy reclaims it. Her Heartsteel stacking and steadfast HP grow faster than your armour matters, and her R counters your whole pattern — Steadfast Presence stops your engage dash and Keeper's Verdict flings your team away the moment you commit. But Verdict is a channel: hold Path Maker's stun or a Q stack for the wind-up and you cancel it outright. You still can't out-scale her bulk-for-bulk, so use your earlier-to-mid windows and first-item disruption to side-lane and close the game.

edits.after: Land Path Maker's stun and your second-stack Q pull while her 20s W is down

edits.before: Use W to block your E dash and your R engage so your mobility and lockdown do nothing

edits.before: Pin you to a wall with E for the extended stun, then Q knock-up and grind the trade

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Poppy, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.

notes: Poppy is referred to as 'he/his/him' in several full-layer fields (tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.carry, report[9]/[12]) — a pronoun sweep is warranted but I had no length-safe rewrite that also added information. I did NOT write any claim that Keeper's Verdict makes Poppy untargetable during the channel: the derived flag says so but Riot's text does not, and telling a player their burst whiffs through it when it may not is worse than saying nothing.
